title: One orientation table for every view and export
note: facing = the direction the road side faces. The map always has the road at the bottom and the back at the top. 'north' is the north direction in plan coordinates (+x along the road to the right, +y away from the road). 'labels' are the map's edge labels; 'roseDegrees' is the clockwise rotation of the map's north arrow from screen-up. Shared by src/utils/compassDirections.ts, the map's compass rose, tools/compass_geometry.north_vector, every drawing and the DXF north arrow. Apply F1 under each facing: only labels, arrows and north change, never geometry.
